comment: Single source of RUNEBOUND look parameters (M06). Read by tools/texgen, tools/modelgen and scripts/systems/art_kit.gd. Colors are sRGB hex; modelgen converts to linear for Blender. v1 = Gate 0 decided by the user in live play (2026-09-23): character outline on, smooth animation, characters 64 px/m over environment 32 px/m.

threat.rule: enemy danger only: filled disc/lane + bright rim + visible fill progress, top render priority, fog-exempt

resonance.rule: player class resource: armor rune glow + HUD bar; never used on enemies

aether.rule: M10 Elementalist class resource: HUD bar + rig rune glow; magenta so it never reads as Resonance gold, the player teal or enemy void violet; never used on enemies

nature.rule: M11 root druid: the Sap bar, rig glow, heals, shields and the ally marker; hue ~100 deg, yellower than the player teal, never used on enemies

player_accent.rule: player identity + targeting UI (Tab ring, frames)

experience.rule: M07 experience: the thin HUD bar, level badge, XP toasts; periwinkle so it never reads as Resonance gold or the player teal

health.rule: M10b the hero's own health: the HUD bar, Healing Draughts and their rising motes; never a filled shape on the ground (filled red there is threat)

fire.rule: Ember Lance, Burn, fire patches: turbulent, rising, short-lived

env_emissive.rule: ember cracks in the Highlands ground: tiny, dim (below glow threshold), slow flicker, never red, never disc-shaped

hearth.rule: settlement windows and lanterns: small lit rectangles, dim (environment cap), never on the ground, never disc-shaped

rarity.rule: loot reads by vertical beam + label shape, not by hue alone

village._rule: M12 abandoned village (Westreach): cool grey-olive earth, dead grass, grey cobble and fieldstone, rotten timber; ground steps 2-3 stay in the 25-40 band

burnt_forest._rule: M12 burnt forest (north-west): charcoal ground (base step 3), grey soot patches, near-black charred bark with dim ember cracks (environment emissive, never threat red)

bone_field._rule: M12 bone field (Emberfall Ridge): dark bone-dust ground in the 25-40 band; pale bone only on props and scatter, so enemies keep +15 L* over the ground

grave_shambler._rule: M12 the Restless (village): grey-green rot skin (base step 2 clears the village ground by >= 15 L*), villager rags, bone claws, sickly gold eyes

mourner._rule: M12 the Restless (village): a pale grey shroud (bright against every ground), a dark veil and hair, cold eyes; not the friendly ghosts' see-through pale (those have no outline)

cinderbark._rule: M12 burnt forest: ash-grey charred bark a step lighter than the forest's trunks, an ash cap, ember cracks and eyes (glow) - the tell that this tree walks

smoulder_wisp._rule: M12 burnt forest: a sooty husk around a burning heart, flame tongues in the forest's ember orange (env embers), hot pale eyes

elementalist.comment: M10: the ranged caster. Steel-blue coat, the player teal on trim and mantle, a gold circlet; the glow is the Aether magenta - never the Duskweaver violet, so a hero caster never reads as the enemy one.

druid.comment: M11: the root druid, the healer. A moss-dark robe under a mantle of leaves, bark plates on the shoulders and left forearm, a deep hood crowned with antlers, a gnarled staff with a glowing seed. The glow is the nature green - never the player teal, never an enemy colour.

runehold.comment: the safe settlement: warmer dawn, living green, grey granite; still the same twilight family as the Highlands

spire.comment: interior: no sun; cold violet stone, crystal light, cyan rune inlays

stonehulk.comment: Highlands/lab brute: weathered stone slabs, moss on the up-facing planes, ember slit eyes

veilstalker.comment: skirmisher: slate cloak (never the player's teal), bone mask for the value read, acid eye slit

hollow_warden.comment: Spire construct: violet-grey slabs, bronze trim, tower shield in front (reads 'not here'), teal rune core on the back (reads 'hit here')

ashvein.comment: Highlands mini-boss (x1.7): ash-grey basalt hide cracked by ember veins; veins and back crystals glow brighter on enrage

vessel.comment: Spire boss (x1.4): floating lavender crystal construct, violet heart, orbiting shards

value_structure.rule: luminance bands (0-100) so gameplay reads before hue: background 15-40, ground 25-40, walls/rocks 20-45, characters key planes 40-70, telegraphs/VFX 80-100

shadows.casters: characters, dressing hulls, props taller than 0.6 m
